name: Siméon-Denis Poisson
summary: French mathematician and mathematical physicist known for contributions to electromagnetism, elasticity, optics, and celestial mechanics.

name: Pithiviers
summary: Small town in France, birthplace of Siméon-Denis Poisson.

name: France
summary: Country where Poisson lived and worked.

name: École Polytechnique
summary: French engineering school where Poisson studied and later taught.

name: Paris Académie des Sciences
summary: Prestigious French scientific academy where Poisson was elected and served.

name: Université Impériale
summary: Reorganized French university system where Poisson was named first professor of mechanics.

name: Royal Council of Public Education
summary: French government body organizing education where Poisson served as member and treasurer.

name: Joseph Fourier
summary: French mathematician and physicist, predecessor and rival of Poisson at École Polytechnique.

name: Pierre-Simon Laplace
summary: French mathematician and astronomer, examiner for mathematics at École Polytechnique and mentor to Poisson.

name: Joseph Louis Lagrange
summary: Italian-French mathematician, professor at École Polytechnique during Poisson's studies.

name: Gaspard Monge
summary: French mathematician, professor at École Polytechnique during Poisson's studies.

name: Adrien-Marie Legendre
summary: French mathematician who reported on Poisson's early paper to the Academy.

name: Sylvestre François Lacroix
summary: French mathematician who reported on Poisson's early paper to the Academy.

name: Augustin Fresnel
summary: French physicist whose wave theory of light was tested by Poisson's suggested experiment.

name: Poisson's equation
summary: Partial differential equation in electromagnetism describing potential in charged bodies.

name: Poisson's ratio
summary: Dimensionless ratio in elasticity measuring transverse strain to primary strain.

name: Poisson's spot
summary: Bright spot in the center of the shadow of a disk, predicted by Poisson based on Fresnel's theory.

name: Poisson distribution
summary: Probability distribution function appearing in Poisson's 1829 essay.

name: Poisson brackets
summary: Mathematical operation in celestial mechanics introduced in Poisson's 1809 essay.

name: Mathematical Theory of Heat
summary: Book by Poisson published in 1835 on heat distribution.

name: Traité de Mécanique
summary: Treatise by Poisson first published in 1811 containing early hints of Poisson's ratio.

name: Société d'Arcueil
summary: Small circle of renowned scientists meeting in Arcueil where Poisson joined Laplace.
